name: RMSNorm
tagline: Replace LayerNorm with RMSNorm (no mean centring, scale-only) while keeping the standard Pre-LN block.
diff_from_baseline: Zhang & Sennrich, NeurIPS 2019 — RMSNorm. Drops the mean subtraction and bias of LayerNorm, leaving only RMS scaling; default normalisation in LLaMA, Gemma, Mistral, and most modern open-weights LLMs.

name: RMSNorm + Parallel block
tagline: Single RMSNorm shared by attention and MLP, whose outputs are summed in one residual (GPT-J / PaLM style).
diff_from_baseline: Wang & Komatsuzaki 2021 (GPT-J) and Chowdhery et al. 2022 (PaLM) — parallel residual block. One norm, attention and MLP share inputs; saves a matmul/norm and stabilises large-scale training.

name: RMSNorm + Sandwich-LN
tagline: Pre- and post-norm wrap each sublayer (CogView-style sandwich) using RMSNorm.

key_hyperparams.name: norms_per_block
key_hyperparams.role: pre+post for each of attn and MLP

diff_from_baseline: Ding et al., NeurIPS 2021 — CogView (Sandwich-LN). Combines Pre-LN's optimisation stability with Post-LN's regularisation effect; widely used for stabilising deep transformer training.
